scope: AUDIT ONLY. S005 reserves the final wiring into RuntimePool.start for HCLI; this does not touch hcli/runtime.py, does not name an anchor, and does not write the patch. It asks whether the 15 green tests would survive a broken implementation.

suite.the_one_red: test_serving_layer_calls_adopt_or_spawn -- asserts adopt_or_spawn( appears in hcli/runtime.py. It is red BY DESIGN and stays red until HCLI closes it. Confirmed still red on this run.
suite.runner_note: python3.12 has no pytest on this host; the suite runs under python3 (pytest 9.1.1)

why_this_audit: '15 of 16 green' says nothing about whether those 15 constrain anything. G005's verify names NINE negative controls, each of which must REAP rather than adopt. A control that passes against a broken adopter is not a control.
method: five mutations of the real mechanisms, each reverted, markers grepped to zero after each

decide() decision core forced to always.reading: six of the nine controls are enforced by the decision core and prove it

the `rec is not None` guard on the ADOPT.reading: the corrupted and truncated controls survive the decide() mutation because a record that cannot be parsed never reaches decide -- _core.load returns None and the ADOPT branch refuses. Defence in depth, not vacuity, and this mutation proves it

_acquire_claim forced to always succeed.reading: the exclusive claim is what makes exactly one adopter win

transfer_interrupted override removed.reading: a crash mid-transfer is caught by an override AFTER decide, not by the core

_foreign_owner_live forced to always ret.reading: NOTHING FAILS. This is the finding.

the_finding.what_it_does: raises CompetingOwnerError when the ownership record names a DIFFERENT live process as owner -- the 'absence of a competing owner' clause named in G005's acceptance
the_finding.coverage: ZERO. Neutering it turns no test red.
the_finding.why_it_hid: test_two_simultaneous_adopters passes through _acquire_claim, the exclusive claim lock. So the competing-owner clause has TWO mechanisms and the suite exercises only one. If _foreign_owner_live regressed, an adopter would take a resident already owned by a live foreign process and no test would notice.
the_finding.status: REPORTED, NOT FIXED. Writing that test is authoring G005's evidence, and G005's closure is HCLI's under S005.

verdict: all nine negative controls are load-bearing on at least one real mechanism -- none is vacuous. The acceptance clause they do NOT fully cover is 'absence of a competing owner', which has an untested second guard.
scar: A SUITE THAT IS GREEN ON A BROKEN IMPLEMENTATION IS A CATALOGUE. Mutate the mechanism, not the test.
